description: Java class 'Combinations' providing an iterable utility for generating combinations (subsets) of size k from a set of size n, including lexicographic iteration order and comparison utilities.

classes.name: Combinations
classes.description:
Utility class for generating combinations of set elements, supports iteration in lexicographic order.
Includes inner classes for iterators and comparison logic.

classes.name: Combinations.IterationOrder
classes.description: Enumeration for specifying iteration order; currently supports only lexicographic order.

classes.name: Combinations.LexicographicIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for generating combinations in lex order, using algorithm T from Knuth.

classes.name: Combinations.SingletonIterator
classes.description: Iterator for degenerate cases with only one possible combination.

classes.name: Combinations.LexicographicComparator
classes.description: Comparator for lexicographic order of combination arrays, with validation.

methods.name: Combinations
methods.description: Constructor for Combinations specifying set size n, subset size k, and iteration order.

methods.name: getN
methods.description: Returns the total size of the set for combinations.

methods.name: getK
methods.description: Returns the size of each combination.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over combination arrays based on the specified order.

methods.name: comparator
methods.description: Returns a comparator to order combinations lexicographically.
